hypothesis: H-P: pull-apart basin-closure corridors at dextral releasing steps mark unmapped boundary faults (see docs/research/hypotheses.md).
mechanism: A closed isostatic-gravity low with basement deepening, bounded by two strike-slip strands with a releasing step, indicates an unmapped boundary fault that a gradient-only method misses.
non_fault_process_that_could_mimic_it: Ordinary sediment-filled basins bounded by normal (range-front) faults, and lacustrine sediment thickness (late Pleistocene lakes obscure faults, S10), produce the same gravity low and basement deepening without any strike-slip step.
